{{trail}}
'''Skills''' are primarily combat-related player competencies (as opposed to [[Blades:Services|services]] like [[Blades:Enchanting|enchanting]] or [[Blades:Crafting#Equipment_Crafting|forging]]) and are split into three sections: Spells, Perks, and Abilities. To learn a skill, you must meet its minimum required player level and have already learned its prerequisite skill (if any), as well as spend its Skill Point cost.
__TOC__
==Spells==
Spells cause a variety of different magical effects that cost Magicka. Ranking up a Spell increases its effectiveness. Other than spending Skill Points to upgrade them, [[Blades:Jewelry|rings]] can give bonus ranks to Spells and Abilities. Like Abilities, Spells must be equipped to be able to use them in combat. Players can only slot 3 Spells at one time. These are represented by 3 icons that appear above the blue Magicka bar at the bottom-left of the player HUD.

When combat starts, Spells start off on spell-specific cooldowns with their icon greyed-out and are unavailable for use. Once available, tapping on the icon will use the Spell, at which point it will go back on cooldown.

==Abilities==
Abilities cause a variety of different combat effects that cost Stamina. Ranking up an Ability increases its effectiveness. Other than spending Skill Points to upgrade them, [[Blades:Jewelry|rings]] can give bonus ranks to Spells and Abilities. Like Spells, Abilities must be equipped to use them in combat. Players can only slot 3 Abilities at one time. They are represented by 3 icons that appear above the green Stamina bar at the bottom-right of the player HUD.

When combat starts, Abilities start off on an ability-specific cooldown with their icon greyed-out and cannot be used immediately. Once available, tapping on the icon will use the Ability, at which point it goes back on cooldown again.
